snippet.title: Ovis Loop | Playtest Trailer
snippet.description:
Hello again, Protectors!
you may have heard, but our sheepish roguelike adventure is getting two pieces of news today. First, our new playtest is available right now on Steam! Second? We're changing our name, and we'd like to introduce you to Ovis Loop!

Ovis Loop represents a new milestone, and we're hoping that you'll join us be heading to Steam and getting your hooves on our hero, Omega, with our new playtest, which you can play now!

We've been inspired by your passion for Ovis Loop, across X (Twitter) our official Lifuel discord and the steam community. All development has been based on players' incredible feedback and we hope you can join us to make Ovis Loop the best game it can be.

You can join us on many platforms, and we hope to see you again soon!

X (Twitter) - https://x.com/lifuelgames
Discord - https://discord.gg/rRd7TgzGjj
Steam Store - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2226730/STANDALONE/
Steam Community - https://steamcommunity.com/app/2226730/discussions/
